## Checklist (tick every box before asking for review)

- [ ] **Brand Guardian compliance check done.** Anything client-facing or public (reels, scripts, posts, client messages) has been through Brand Guardian: no guarantees, no return or earnings claims, no product or insurer promotion, general education only. For IG reels, podcast and Career DNA that pass is the approval; LinkedIn also needs Albert. No GE pre-approval for those; GE approval still applies to client newsletters and recruitment ads.
- [ ] **No client data.** No names, NRIC, phone numbers, emails, policy numbers, health details or any other personal data (PDPA). Templates use placeholders only.
- [ ] **Figures come from the fact pack.** Every Singapore figure (CPF, MediShield Life, tax, grants, retirement sums, etc.) matches [`compliance/sg-fact-pack-2026-11.md`](../compliance/sg-fact-pack-2026-11.md) or links to an official source checked on a stated date. Anything unchecked is marked **UNVERIFIED**.
- [ ] **GitHub Actions pinned to full commit SHAs.** Every `uses:` line points at a 40-character SHA (with a `# vX` comment), never a tag or branch.
- [ ] No files moved or renamed without the owner director's OK.
- [ ] `docs/INDEX.md` updated if this PR adds a new pack or document.
